notes: Production/main and central TAKY canonical remain unchanged
Confirmed Ready & Set timer visual authority is preserved
Recording remains part of the active learning session and does not pause/end the timer
BGM stops before microphone capture; browser/device echo cancellation, noise suppression and automatic gain control remain enabled
A realtime local Web Audio chain adds high-pass, low-pass and mild dynamics compression before the submitted recording is encoded; no paid API or cloud audio processing is used
The browser's first encoded capture is preserved separately as ORIGINAL with an 'original' filename suffix
The submitted/transferred recording never receives a clean/original suffix and its base filename is editable before transfer
Default submitted filename is Judy's grammar recording YYYY MM DD with zero-padded date
M4A/AAC is the first-choice capture and transfer format where the browser supports audio/mp4; unsupported environments preserve and disclose the actual format rather than faking .m4a
ORIGINAL and realtime-clean transfer use the same selected recorder MIME/container when dual recording is supported
Filename preview shows the exact submitted filename and fixed actual extension
Internal storage keeps ORIGINAL and CLEAN/transfer records linked by sourceOriginalId
Zero-cost / zero-wait local optimization remains the default for most runtime features; character generation and Guide/Explorer-team generation remain explicit exceptions
Real iPhone microphone acoustics, iOS audio/mp4 dual-recorder behavior and native share sheet remain device-validation pending
